description: AAASM-5353: 統一編號 valid ONLY under the post-2023-04-01 rule. Weights [1,2,1,2,1,2,4,1] over 10000004 give products 1 and 4, weighted digit-sum 5: divisible by 5, NOT by 10. Every mod-10-valid number is also mod-5-valid, so a legacy-only validator passes every pre-2023 test and misses every business registered since April 2023 - this vector is the only one that discriminates.
